chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from his father ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: At what age in years and months is the funeral prayer performed for a child? He said: The prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he miscarries before completion.

Thus, the way to understand these two reports is what we stated regarding the report of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān: that they are to be understood as taqiyyah, or as indicating a kind of recommendation rather than obligation and requirement.

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: dissimulation for protection in sensitive legal circumstances
key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the child over whom the ruling is being asked
key_terms.يَسْقُطَ: to miscarry or be dropped from the womb

ai.seo_question: When is salat performed over a deceased child according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of performing salat over a deceased child. It states that the prayer is performed in every case except when the fetus miscarries before completion, and the compiler explains that certain reports on the issue are to be understood through taqiyyah or as recommending the act rather than making it obligatory.
